reviews.name: Stephanie Neville
reviews.text: I had an absolutely unforgettable experience on the Surf Yoga Beer Kenya trip from start to finish. The views across the Maasai Mara were beyond anything I could have imagined, and the hot air balloon safari was a true highlight—watching the sunrise over the savannah, spotting wildlife from above, and then enjoying a gourmet breakfast out in the middle of the wilderness was an unforgettable experience. A huge thank you to our amazing guides, Eli and Bri, who went above and beyond every single day. Their knowledge, positivity, and incredible energy made every game drive and every moment even more enjoyable, and it was clear how much they genuinely cared about giving us the best possible experience. Everything was exceptionally well organized, and I felt taken care of throughout the entire trip. If you’re considering a Surf Yoga Beer adventure, don’t hesitate—it was truly the trip of a lifetime, and I couldn’t recommend it more highly.

reviews.name: Joe Gansky
reviews.text: I just got back from the Kenya trip, and it was an incredible experience with our group leaders Eli and Brianna. They made every day memorable, so If you’re thinking about booking a trip, make sure you go with Eli and Brianna. You wont regret it!

reviews.name: Jacklyn Adams
reviews.text:
Second SYB trip in the books and Nicaragua was a TIME! Also so gorgeous! If you’re a sunset lover like me you’ll fall in love.

Quick recap of the itinerary: ATV’d (everywhere), rode horseback at sunrise, went deep-sea fishing, explored a local town, hit a karaoke bar, surfed daily, and even summited a shark-fin-shaped rock (see pics!)

I think what I love about Surf Yoga Beer is how easy they make everything. You seriously just show up and enjoy. The itinerary is thoughtful and the vibes are immaculate. It’s very clear they’ve done this many times!

I’m already booked for my next SYB adventure in Kenya with friends I met on a previous trip (check out Amalfi too 😉). If you want unforgettable memories and real connections, this is it. Don’t think, just do!

reviews.name: Katie Hall
reviews.text: I couldn’t imagine another trip topping SYB Kenya ‘24, but SYB Nica was truly incredible. Both times I’ve left with new friends that feel more like family. These trips are a perfect mix of pushing yourself, seeing new things, moments of reflection, and what felt like endless laughter. The trip leaders (Mantas, Steph, Eli, Erin and Rob) have all been top notch. As they’d say - don’t think, just do 🙂

reviews.name: Zulema Rivero
reviews.text: I attended my first ever SYB trip this year, when we took Kenya in June, and I plan to embark on my next adventure with SYB as soon as I can!! SYB Kenya was a truly special experience thanks to the immaculate organisation by the team involved and the amazing bunch of people that SYB put together to make these outstanding experiences happen! We all left our homes to go on a trip to Kenya and got back with a new group of friends - who I hope to reunite with real soon! The trip of a lifetime! If you’re looking to embark on an amazing experience at one of SYB’s exotic destinations without having to worry about anything, but just get yourself there and let the good times roll, then SYB has to be your go-to company! I’d like to take the opportunity to thank the team leaders Steph, Eli and Duncan for the awesome vibes and making sure we all had the bestEST time in Kenya! ♥️

reviews.name: Paige Day
reviews.text:
Life changing is an understatement!
I joined Surf Yoga Beer for the 2024 Nicaragua NYE trip and left with a full heart, a whole new group of amazing friends, and memories that genuinely changed my life. (I even left with a new tattoo)
I loved it so much that I immediately booked the Kenya trip and just got back from that one. From the sunrise hot air balloon ride to taking a shot of Kenya Cane every time we spotted an animal, every moment was unforgettable.
Already counting down to my next SYB trip in 2026. Can’t recommend it enough!!!

reviews.name: Ryan Erickson
reviews.text: I just returned from my SurfYogaBeer Kenya trip. Words truly can’t do this experience justice. From amazing trip leaders (Steph and Eli and of course Duncan with the assists), to the most incredible action packed itinerary, seeing so much wildlife and beauty all across the country of Kenya, and to the amazing bonds made with new friends. As my first time doing anything like this, the leaders made it a point to make me feel welcome and safe being across the world with a group of strangers. SYB finds a way to bring this group of people who didn’t know each other prior, into what feels like an extended family by the end of the week. I can’t wait to go on my next trip and see both some familiar and new faces! Thank you SYB

reviews.name: Hanna Read
reviews.text: I recently returned from the SYB Kenya trip (my first with SYB) and it was really the trip of a lifetime. Not only was the location amazing, but the trip was well planned and coordinated with amazing activities, hotels, food and fitness. We also had super strong leaders, Steph and Eli and the group was awesome. SYB attracts people who are looking for adventure and interested in meeting new people. It was fun to see so many people with different backgrounds and from around the world. I can’t wait to go on my next trip with SYB!!

reviews.name: Sierra Vigna
reviews.text: SYB Kenya was absolutely life changing! Steph and Eli made everything so smooth and simple - the experiences provided to you and people you encounter make this company unlike any other. ♥️ truly so grateful

reviews.name: Erika O
reviews.text: KENYA2025 what an incredible experience! So well organized and our group becoming close was an additional bonus. Shout out to Steph, Eli, Duncan and Beth for leading this trip! I can’t wait to hang out with everyone at reunions and go on other trips! JAMBO!!!

reviews.name: Morgan Effron
reviews.text: I had so much fun on SYB Kenya!  I had always wanted to do a Safari, so when I saw one for solo travelers I had to jump on it.  The group was so amazing and it is hard to believe we were strangers before meeting in Nairobi.  Steph and Eli helped us set goals and intentions for the week, so we could work together to make sure everyone had the experience they were hoping for.  The programming was seamless.  The workouts were fun and tailored to our ability.  The animals showed off for us.  The hot air balloon was incredible.  I can't wait to travel with SYB again!

reviews.name: Rochelle Gluck
reviews.text: 100% if you're thinking about it, book it! I just went on my first SYB trip to Kenya and it was the best trip of my life. Every detail was well thought out and they only give you the best - from the accommodations to the food to the activities. The leaders are so welcoming, and friendly and truly take care of you and every detail. One thing that is not talked about often, but a luxury, is having a photographer on the trip, you can really enjoy and genuinely be present and not worry about capturing every moment because they are. Plus their pics/videos will probably (definitely) be better than yours. I will absolutely be booking another SYB trip very shortly. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.name: Margaret Ma
reviews.text: I finally took my COVID delayed safari trip with SYB and it was amazing! While I'm sad that I didn't go as planned in 2020, I'm so happy I finally took the trip earlier this summer. This was an amazing way to see the country/animals with such a fun group of people led by energetic people who couldn't be more friendly. And the fact that we had a professional photographer with us couldn't be beat because I didn't have to worry about capturing everything I was seeing, I could just sit back, relax and enjoy. I highly recommend SYB to people, even if travelling solo, who want to experience new places, stay active and meet a fun group of people!

reviews.name: Katie Roberts
reviews.text:
I did my first SYB trip to Kenya this summer and can only say good things about it.  My only negative is that I didn't book with them sooner.  This was their first trip to Kenya and you wouldn't have known it.  Each day got better and better, culminating in my favorite day of all at the end - a hot air balloon at sunrise, a champagne breakfast, afternoon yoga, and then a sunset safari.  It was truly a once in a lifetime trip that I will remember forever.
One of the best things about this company is its philosophy as it attracts the best people to the trips.  I'm so happy to finally be a part of this community and am looking forward to my next adventure with them!

reviews.name: Nicolas ansara
reviews.text: All I can say is WOW Kenya. I’m still day-dreaming about this trip and what a wild and incredible adventure that it truly was.  For their first trip to Kenya all of my expectations were blown out of the water. The trip started off on a high note for me, by having the opportunity to get up close and personal with giraffes and lions while feeding them out of my hands! The experiences only elevated from there! From riding bicycles through Hell’s Gate, taking our land rovers off-roading to chase down cheetahs and leopards, to an epic sunrise Hot air balloon safari over the Maasai Mara. Just to name a few. But one of my favorite things about an SYB trip are the people you meet along the way.  This trip took 19 strangers, dropped then off in Africa, and turned them into friends that will last a lifetime.  I cannot wait for the next SYB adventure!

reviews.name: Cezary Wójcik
reviews.text:
I think of a great travel experience in two parts -- to put it in the universal language of sandwich, the bread and the filling. And the SYB Kenya trip was a hell of a sando.

You can't have a sandwich without the bread (lettuce wrapped is no longer a sandwich). In travel, I see the bread as the destination, the sights, the experiences. Kenya was incredible. We saw lions and cheetahs and zebras up close in the wild in a way to which no zoo can ever compare. We flew over the Masai Mara in a calming and beautiful air balloon ride at sunrise. And we got our sweat on together any time we could by the poolside or in the courtyard while confused onlookers were wondering what the hell we were doing.

The filling of the sandwich, however, is the people with whom you share these experiences. It's the little moments in between all of the adventuring and sightseeing created purely by the people you're with, like vibing out to the Lion King soundtrack while 4x4ing between leopard sightings. It's spending time with people reveling in the moment and thrilled by the memories yet to be made. It's the realization of the idea that no matter where in the world you are or where you're from, we're all just human beings who are meant to enjoy things together. That's where the sandwich really gets its flavor, and that's a big part of what makes SYB so special. A group united from a combination of extended community and shared interests that starts as mostly strangers and ends as a team.

reviews.name: Jessica Chan
reviews.text: I've joined two of these trips - Croatia '21 and Kenya '22. Both were fantastic! Each trip has a consistent theme of being active and adventurous, yet is inclusive to the point where if you don't want to participate in some activities or workouts, there's no pressure to do so. Mantas, Steph, and the other leaders are absolutely lovely and have made what can be an initimidating week-long trip with a group of strangers very welcoming and comfortable. I have met some incredible people on these trips who I am now able to call friends and this is why I keep coming back!
